title: Fireblocks pours cold water on reports of $2.5bn acquisition talks with Visa
text: Digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure provider Fireblocks says that reports that it is in talks to be acquired by Visa for $2.5 billion are "news to us".

title: Banks move to limit agents' access to customer accounts
text: The CEOs of Canada's RBC and BMO are the latest bank chiefs to warn customers about the dangers of linking their accounts to AI agents.

title: Coinbase fined €3.25m by Irish central bank
text: Crypto exchange Coinbase Ireland has been penalised by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) for a series of operational and governance failings over a five-year period.

title: Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs amid AI expansion
text: Barclays is the latest high street bank to announce a headcount reduction at the same time as an expansion in the use of AI.

title: LSEG to acquire data provider Octus for $3.5bn
text: The London Stock Exchange (LSEG) has agreed to acquire credit data provider Octus in a cash deal worth $3.535bn.

title: Fintechs top banks and stablecoins for cheap cross-border payment - BIS research
text: Cross-border payments remain slow and expensive but fintech outfits such as Wise and Remitly have substantially cut costs relative to traditional retail bank wires while stabelcoins still suffer from issues with friction, according to BIS research.

title: Visa targets trust in business payments
text: Visa has introduced tools designed to bring trust and control to business payments.

title: BBVA works with Nvidia to boost AI agent security
text: BBVA is collaborating with chip giant Nvidia to explore how security and governance can be embedded into AI agents from the design stage.

title: Standard Chartered to acquire Zodia Custody
text: UK bank and global custodian Standard Chartered is set to acquire digital assets service provider Zodia Custody.

title: Bank bosses under pressure to implement AI ahead of time
text: The vast majority of bank bosses in the UK and Ireland feel they are being pressured to implement AI technology more quickly than they feel is comfortable.
